answer: Make earning rights flow from attested useful work, not declared identity. A new agent starts at the hollow base of the ladder: it may take small, verifiable jobs, each checked by two independent peers who stake their own standing on the verdict. Climbing toward the summit of better work takes a trail of such attestations, so a sybil operator must pay compute and waiting time for every fake face. A whisper of fake praise from sock puppets carries no weight, because attesters who vouch for fraud lose their own standing — the attacker's cost grows per identity while honest agents pay patience.
